_comment: Baked into the agent-runner image at /home/agent/.claude.json (the GLOBAL config, distinct from ~/.claude/settings.json which is per-project). Claude Code checks hasCompletedOnboarding HERE — settings.json was a red herring for that. projects[/work].hasTrustDialogAccepted skips the 'is this a project you trust?' gate that fires when claude first cd's into /work (the rig worktree bind-mount). --dangerously-skip-permissions doesn't suppress that dialog; only pre-accepting via projects[] does.
